_meta.datasheet_section: Pin Configuration (DHC package, top view) p2 + Pin Functions p7-8 + Order Information p2; package DHC16 LTC DWG 05-08-1706 Rev 0
_meta.package: DHC 16-lead DFN 5x3x0.75 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, EP = pin 17
_meta.notes: Grounds are typed power in our factory by design (FLEX_GND convention).

pins.name: SWB
pins.note: Phase B switch node; inductor to VIN

pins.name: SWA
pins.note: Phase A switch node; inductor to VIN

pins.name: VIN
pins.note: 1.8 V max start-up (VOUT=0); >=10 uF ceramic to PGND

pins.name: PWM/SYNC
pins.note: Do not leave floating. High=PWM, Low=Burst, clock=sync (then RT resistor required)

pins.name: VC
pins.note: Error-amp output; compensation network to SGND

pins.name: FB
pins.note: VOUT = 1.2 V*(1+R1/R2); divider bottom to SGND

pins.name: SD
pins.note: Do not leave floating. >1.6 V on, <0.25 V off (output disconnected)

pins.name: VOUTA
pins.note: Must be tied to VOUTB; >=10 uF per phase

pins.name: NC
pins.note: Not connected internally; DS: connect to VOUTA/VOUTB for copper

pins.name: CAP
pins.note: ~100 nF low-ESR from CAP to VOUT

pins.name: PGND
pins.note: Exposed pad is PGND; must be soldered to the PCB ground plane
